# Checking a Reserved Guest in

Guests can be checked in using two methods:

* **Through the table reservation screen:**
  * In the Table Reservation screen, select the guest from the booking list in the left panel and click on the ellipsis (three dots) corresponding to the guest.&#x20;
  * Select **Seated from the pop-up window**.&#x20;

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (232).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

#### <mark style="color:blue;">From the TPOS Screen</mark>

* In TPOS, click the reserved table.&#x20;
* A pop-up message will appear, prompting for a check-in.&#x20;
* Click Yes to check in the table.&#x20;

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (233).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

* Once the Guest is seated, the pop-up screen prompting reservation check-in is displayed. Click OK to proceed.

<div align="left"><figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (234).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure></div>

* Once Check-in is initiated, the reservation status color on the Table reservation screen changes.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (235).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

#### <mark style="color:blue;">To Customize the Reservation Statuses,</mark>

* **Go to POS>>Masters3 >> Outlet settings.**

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (236).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

* **Click Open file** <img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/unknown (5).png" alt="" data-size="line">&#x20;
* Select **Main Menu**&#x20;
* Select **All-day Dining** from the Outlet drop-down.&#x20;
* Click on the colored boxes to open the color palette.&#x20;
* Select the colors from the given palettes.&#x20;
* **Save** <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" data-size="line">&#x20;

Once the guest is checked in, another pop-up message will appear, after which the KOT process can be initiated.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (237).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
